first: Please write my CV first, then the cover letter.
cover_letter: Thank you. Now please write the cover letter.
exit: Thanks, that is all. Please exit.
clarify_job_ad: That is all the information the ad gives.
missing_details: I'd rather leave those details out.
purpose: Two ordinary revision requests to the CV: shorten the summary, then reorder the sections.
correct_behaviour: Each request changes the CV as asked and keeps the earlier change; nothing else is changed and nothing is invented.

requests.text: Please shorten the professional summary to two sentences.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final CV's summary is at most two sentences.

requests.text: Thanks. Now please move the skills section above the work experience.
requests.correct_behaviour: The final CV has the skills section before the work experience, and the summary is still at most two sentences.
